standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 3323-3324)

standard_prerequisites.name: The double dual statement identifying a finite module with the internal hom of its Ext into the dualizing complex
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3331-3335)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns a single nonzero Ext into an identification of the module as an Ext of the resulting module.

standard_prerequisites.name: The bound of the depth of a finite module by the dimension of its support
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3338-3339)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the reverse inequality that upgrades the single-nonzero condition to Cohen-Macaulayness.

core_obligations: First implications: if the module is Cohen-Macaulay then only the Ext in degree minus the dimension of the support can be nonzero, which gives the vanishing condition, and that condition immediately gives the at most one nonzero Ext condition (proof lines 3325-3328)

Converse: take the nonzero Ext and let the depth be the corresponding degree; the double dual statement identifies the original module with an Ext of that module, so the depth is at least the dimension of the support, while the general bound gives the reverse inequality, hence the module is Cohen-Macaulay (proof lines 3329-3340)

The auto-equivalence: the same double dual identification shows that the degree minus the depth Ext of a Cohen-Macaulay module of depth d is again Cohen-Macaulay of depth d, and applying the equivalence of the first items gives the anti-auto-equivalence (proof lines 3342-3347)
proof_roadmap: 由 sitting-in-degrees 的结果：Ext^i_A(M, ω_A^•) 只在 i = -depth 与 -dim Supp 相关的少数次数可能非零。
(1)⇒(3)⇒(2) 直接。设 (2)，取非零的 N = Ext^{-δ}(M, ω^•)，δ = depth(M)。
由 dualizing 引理的双对偶 M[0] = RHom(RHom(M,ω),ω) = RHom(N[δ], ω) ⇒ M = Ext^{-δ}(N, ω^•) ⇒ δ ≥ dim Supp(M)；与一般界 δ ≤ dim Supp(M) 合并得 Cohen-Macaulay。
对 CM_d 的最终断言同理：N = Ext^{-d}(M,ω^•) 满足 M[0] = RHom(N[d], ω^•)，由 (1)⇔(3) 得 N ∈ CM_d，且该对应双向。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes finite Cohen-Macaulay modules over a Noetherian local ring with normalized dualizing complex by the vanishing pattern of Ext into that complex, and shows that Ext in degree minus the depth is an anti-auto-equivalence of the category of Cohen-Macaulay modules of fixed depth (author lemma at source lines 3306-3320, label lemma-local-CM). The proof (source lines 3322-3348) uses the degree confinement of those Ext modules, proves the easy implications, derives the converse from the double dual identification combined with the bound of depth by the dimension of the support, and reuses that identification for the anti-auto-equivalence (proof lines 3342-3347). The double dual step and the depth bound are the substance. H3.
